intro: Niger has about 27 million people and the world's highest birth rate.

chapters.title: People
text: The Hausa are the largest group, followed by the Zarma-Songhai, Tuareg, Fula and Kanuri. French is official; Hausa is widely spoken. Almost everyone is Muslim.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Niamey, on the Niger River, is the capital.

keyTerms.meaning: How many babies are born per person each year.
